name: prot-paper
description: Prototype in Paper: build two or more structurally different design directions on the canvas from real source data and existing tokens.

steps.name: Setup
steps.instruction: get_guide (paper-mcp-instructions), get_basic_info, get_tokens. Resolve {prefix}, {token_files}, {framework} and {font} per project-conventions.md, then get_font_family_info on {font}. get_tree_summary on artboards that may hold components to clone. Paper disconnected: stop with setup steps, no fallback canvas.

steps.name: Source extraction
steps.instruction: Read the codebase before designing: component names with props and state, data models (types, enums, constants), real content, interaction patterns, and image assets on disk for paper-asset:// insertion. Build an inventory; no lorem ipsum.
checklist: Inventory of real components, data and content

steps.name: Design variant A
steps.instruction: Per section: lead with the interaction concept, show real data in context, one write_html per visual group, get_screenshot every 2-3 sections. Name frames {Section}: {Role}. Each section answers a question the previous one raised; hierarchy comes from interaction density, not eyebrow labels. Clone existing components with duplicate_nodes. Motion only as frame strips.
checklist: Every section shows a working interactive concept
Only var({prefix}*) values and the project font

steps.name: Variants
steps.instruction: Build at least one more artboard with a different interaction model (scroll, tabs, cards), narrative (chronological, thematic) or density (progressive, all visible). Name them {Page} - Variant A: {Concept}, {Page} - Variant B: {Concept}.
checklist: Two or more structurally different directions

steps.name: Review
steps.instruction: Screenshot each variant, compare how well each serves the page's purpose, call finish_working_on_nodes on every touched artboard, and recommend one with a reason.
checklist: Variants compared against the page's purpose

tone: Bold and opinionated. Creative direction, not mechanical extraction. Every choice is grounded in the user's journey.
